string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: The cross moves like a spring: each item arrives with a little inertia and its neighbours follow just after, like a wave
Two built-in icon packs, Symbol and Duotone, redraw the apps in the style of the cross (Settings › Home screen › Icon pack)
Short, soft sounds when moving through the cross, switching group and opening; they stay quiet while something is playing and can be turned off

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: Moving with the arrows, do the items glide smoothly, without jumps, even when you press fast?
Choosing Symbol or Duotone in Icon pack, do the apps in Apps show only their light symbol?
With nothing playing, do you hear a soft tick when moving and a different one when changing group?
